Triage this issue/request: <issue>

Read repository policy and inspect enough current code/docs to judge it accurately.

Return:
- classification: bug / feature / security / docs / maintenance / support / duplicate / needs-info;
- severity/priority with rationale;
- affected area and likely owner modules;
- reproduction or acceptance criteria;
- security/privacy/data-loss impact;
- dependencies/blockers;
- recommended labels/milestone grouping if the repo uses them;
- next concrete action;
- whether it is ready for implementation.

Do not claim a root cause without evidence.
